reserveReview.rationale: The issuer API's 2026-10-07T14:38:35.000Z snapshot lists five custody addresses per asset. Summing its positive external backing rows gives USDC 16,904,991.110392 and USDtb 20,915.8416401, totaling 16,925,906.9520321; the disclosed allocation is 99.876427% USDC and 0.123573% USDtb. The authored 99.9/0.1 rows retain the megausd-custody adapter's one-decimal rounding and exact source identities. All USDm self-token backing rows are zero and are excluded. The same response reports supply 31,371.7707062666; that difference from aggregate backing is not independently reconciled and is not converted into a liability, collateralization or excess-reserve claim. This is a dated issuer portfolio observation, not an independent examination. USDtb's underlying BUIDL is not duplicated as direct MegaUSD backing.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: These provider rows describe upstream collateral context, not identified immediate MegaUSD reserve custodians. The issuer API labels reserve wallets by address and the Mint User Agreement refers to unnamed institutional custodians with reserves separate from operating accounts. Public material does not independently prove who controls each custody wallet, enforceable segregation, insolvency treatment or reuse restrictions. No favorable protection or lower unknown exposure is inferred.
